HappyLens reference and attribution
===================================
Source: https://github.com/WenguanZhang/HappyLens
Reference revision: 8456f7d9e1fb3264f86b05a4ca43c29173e059ea
License: Apache License 2.0 (HappyLens-LICENSE.txt).
Original notice: HappyLens-UPSTREAM-NOTICE.txt.

Optical System Design's descriptor generation, Delano proposal construction and
population/local search workflow were developed with reference to HappyLens's
lens/delano.py, lens/system.py, lens/optim.py and test_prime/test_gen_prime.py.
The C# implementation uses Optical System Design's shared Core; it is not a
Python port or a claim of identical algorithm, sampling or numerical behavior.
No HappyLens Python runtime, networks or bundled third-party neural-network
implementations are included in product computation.

The separate tools/diagnostics/HappyLens20261029/run_upstream.py exercise runs
the downloaded unmodified library with reduced finite budgets. Downloaded
source and the task-local Python environment are not product dependencies.
